_comment: Flow's visible sparkle is a white star at 30% opacity: shown = 0.7*original + 0.3*255*coverage. sparkle.png is its coverage mask (white = fully covered) in a 120x120 window; 'star' is the star width in px and 'centroid' its center inside the window, both at scale 1 (an image). The mask is an analytic star |x|^0.644+|y|^0.644<=27^0.644 (sharp tips, concave sides) fitted to the measured coverage.
